g.title: W_19V
g.text: 13.2 A continuous at 250 W, about 8.7 A at 165 W

g.title: NODE_DC
g.text: into the AXB35's DC-045D jack, polarity to meter
size not measured; no plug rated for 8.7 A found yet

g.title: UNIT_FP
g.text: plug to unit J2 (slot A) / J52 (slot B)

g.title: W_FP
g.text: 4 ways of halogen-free ribbon, stripe = pin 1, round the plane to the header; PLED is polarised

g.title: NODE_FP
g.text: the header's ground pins stay open
